news.title: Mrugesh Trading Limited Announces Resignation of Managing Director Arpit Piyushbhai Shah and Appointment of Babubhai Bhalabhai Makwana as Managing Director, Effective February 20, 2026
news.body: Mrugesh Trading Limited announced that Mr. Arpit Piyushbhai Shah resigned from the post of Managing Director of the Company effective February 20, 2026, due to personal reasons. Mr. Babubhai Bhalabhai Makwana was appointed as Managing Director of the Company effective February 20, 2026. Mr. Babubhai Bhalabhai Makwana is a highly experienced business professional with over 15 years of expertise in business management and accounting. Possesses strong knowledge in financial reporting, budgeting, accounts management, and overall business operations. Committed to delivering efficient financial solutions and maintaining high standards of accuracy and compliance.

news.title: New major risk - Shareholder dilution
news.body: The company's shareholders have been substantially diluted in the past year. Over 2947x increase in shares outstanding. This is considered a major risk. Shareholder dilution occurs when there is an increase in the number of shares on issue that is not proportionally distributed between all shareholders. Often due to the company raising equity capital or some options being converted into stock. All else being equal, if there are more shares outstanding then each existing share will be entitled to a lower proportion of the company's total earnings, thus reducing earnings per share (EPS).
